name: Mage Summoner
summary: Sentinel Velene Starstrike sends a strike south from Silverwind Refuge. After investigating corrupted water elementals near Mystral Lake, the Sentinels send adventurers across the border into the Barrens to kill the undead mage Sarilus Foulborne atop Dreadmist Peak.

sections.title: A Crossing of Borders
sections.body: Night elves rarely send scouts south into the Barrens without grave cause. After investigating unnatural disturbances among the water elementals around Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike traces the meddling to Sarilus Foulborne, a Forsaken conjurer practicing his arts just across the border. For the Sentinels at Silverwind Refuge, an enemy sorcerer defiling nature so close to their home cannot be tolerated.

sections.title: The Conjurer on the Peak
sections.body: Sarilus Foulborne has made his lair high on Dreadmist Peak, a craggy mountain crawling with Burning Blade cultists. From there, he summons ranks of water elementals and bends them to his will, defying night elf authority from Horde lands. Reaching him means braving enemy territory and cutting through his summoned forces. The Sentinels demand his severed head as proof that their vengeance reaches beyond the forest line.

sections.title: Blessing of Elune
sections.body: Velene Starstrike receives Foulborne's severed head and gives his slayer the Light of Elune. This sacred draught of moonlight is a treasured ward among priestesses and Sentinels, granting complete protection when death is near. The gift recalls the night elves' divine favor as foul magic spreads through Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Sarilus Foulborne is an undead mage who fled into the Barrens and made his home atop Dreadmist Peak. He uses arcane summoning to enslave water elementals, drawing the Sentinels' anger from nearby Ashenvale.
Dreadmist Peak is a craggy mountain in the northern Barrens, directly south of the Ashenvale border. Sarilus Foulborne waits at its highest point.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Velene Starstrike want Sarilus dead?
faq.answer: Sarilus has been defiling and corrupting water elementals near the Ashenvale border. Velene finds his defiance intolerable and seeks to end his unnatural conjurations, proving enemies cannot mock the Sentinels from across the border.

faq.q: What is the Light of Elune given as a reward?
faq.answer: The Light of Elune is a rare vial blessed with divine moonlight. Drink it in dire moments to become entirely immune to damage and spell effects for a brief time, escaping otherwise certain death.
Before this, adventurers gather intact bracers from the divining water elementals around Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. Velene uses them to identify who is manipulating the elementals.

faq.q: Why is entering the Barrens dangerous for Alliance players?
faq.answer: The Barrens belongs to the Horde and is home to tauren and orcs. Alliance soldiers and adventurers who enter risk interception by Horde patrols and rival champions.

angles.text: Sarilus's arcane defilement of nature across the forest border insults the Kaldorei. His execution concerns both woodland balance and pride.
Striking a Forsaken target deep in the Barrens makes a bold show of force against Horde encroachments along Ashenvale's southern frontier.
Confronting Foulborne pits Alliance arcanists against an undead practitioner who twists elemental conjuration to reckless extremes.
Receiving the Light of Elune from the Sentinels links your path to the Goddess's rare, miraculous grace against undead corruption.
